title: Unify Cad And Puzzle3d Infinite World
description: Migrate @semio-tech/infinite-world-r3f and puzzle/3d to native z-up; rebuild cad/js/renderer on the same engine with full layer set (chunking, pooling, LOD grid).
summary: Fixed CAD spatial interactions (box, etc.) after infinite-world unification: WorldLodGridHelper grids now disable raycasting (matching legacy cad GridHelper), so GroundPickPlane receives pointer hits again. Added world test; minor GroundPickPlane renderOrder tweak.
